_note: Machine-readable copy of references/structure.md. Ids are stable. indent_ta = 타 (character cells); 2타 = 1 한글 char = 2 half-width chars. No official pt or mm value exists (see structure.md section 2). Sources: S01 (2025 행정업무운영 편람), S02 (시행규칙 제2조, 제4조).

item_rules.hangul_sequence: 가나다라마바사아자차카타파하, then 거너더러머버서어저처커터퍼허 when a level has more than 14 items
item_rules.wrapped_line: align to the first letter of the item text (원칙) or to the left base line; one way per document

end_cases.text: Body ends with text: after the last character, 2 spaces, then `끝.`
Last line reaches the right limit: next line at the left base line, 2 spaces, then `끝.`
Body ends with a table and the last cell is filled: below the table at the left base line, 2 spaces, then `끝.`
Table ends before the last row or cell: no `끝.`; write `이하 빈칸` in the cell after the last filled cell
The document has 붙임: `끝.` goes after the last 붙임 line, not after the body
Draft by 문서관리카드: `끝.` may be omitted

attach_cases.text: Two or more: `붙임  1. ○○○계획서 1부.` then `2. ○○○서류 1부.  끝.` (no colon after 붙임)

blocks.text: 기안자, 검토자, 협조자, 결재권자: 직위(직급) and signature
